documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation
Board Meeting Intimation for Consideration And Approval Of The Unaudited Standalone And Consolidated Financial Results Of The Company For The Quarter Ended September 30, 2026.
Compliances-Certificate under Reg. 74 (5) of SEBI (DP) Regulations, 2018

analysis.summary: ASK Automotive reported strong Q1 FY27 financial results marked by record quarterly revenue, EBITDA, and PAT, driven by robust domestic demand and structural tailwinds in the two-wheeler sector. Management raised its full-year revenue growth guidance to high teens, supported by expanding value-added segments, new order wins, and aggressive capacity expansion plans, including a new plant in the South. Despite headwinds from volatile aluminum alloy prices, the company maintained strong operational performance and complete pass-through mechanisms with customers. ASK Automotive reported consolidated revenue growth of 52.1% YoY for Q1 FY27, outperforming industry growth. Absolute EBITDA grew 32.7% YoY to Rs.

guidance.claim: Management revised the full-year revenue growth guidance from mid-teens to high-teens.
guidance.quote: We are confident that we will continue to grow not only in mid-teens, but we will be now growing for the full year in high teens.

guidance.claim: Export revenue is projected to increase by 20% in the current fiscal year.
guidance.quote: Last year, we could not go near the target anywhere, but this time, we have given a guidance of 20% increase in the exports, and at the moment, we are still very confident we'll achieve it.

guidance.claim: Confirmed orders for alloy wheels stand at Rs. 70 crore to Rs. 90 crore for the current financial year and approximately Rs. 250 crore for the next financial year.
guidance.quote: We have confirmed orders of about Rs. 70 crore to Rs. 90 crore depending on how the customer gear up for this financial year. However, for next financial year, we have confirmed orders of about Rs. 250 crore.

guidance.claim: Exports to Ford Motors are expected to be Rs. 40 crore to Rs. 45 crore this year and around Rs. 60 crore next year.
guidance.quote: As regards your second question of Ford Motors, we will be doing exports of about Rs. 40 to Rs. 45 crore this year, and next year, it is likely to go up to Rs. 60 crore.

guidance.claim: ASK Automotive expects revenue growth to continue around mid-teens in FY27.
guidance.quote: We are confident that will continue to grow around mid-teens in FY27.

guidance.claim: The company's real growth in FY27 will be 4% higher than published year-on-year growth due to the wheel assembly business phase-out.
guidance.quote: On year-on-year comparison in FY27 also, our real growth will be 4% higher than the published growth on year-on-year basis.

guidance.claim: ASK Automotive expects alloy wheels revenue of around Rs. 90 to Rs. 100 Cr in FY27 and about Rs. 220 Cr in FY28.
guidance.quote: FY27 we are expecting revenue of around Rs. 90 - Rs. 100 Cr and FY28 will be about Rs. 220 Cr.

guidance.claim: The company is confident of achieving 20% export growth in FY27 if the geopolitical situation remains stable.
guidance.quote: This year we are very confident of growing at 20%, provided the geopolitical situation remains reasonable, which we are as an optimist, which we feel that it shall be sorted out soon rather than later.

demand_outlook.claim: Domestic demand remains robust and private consumption is resilient.
demand_outlook.quote: Domestic demand remains robust, private consumption is resilient, and the Government of India's structural reforms, particularly GST 2.0, continue to energize the broader economy and, importantly for us the automobile sector, given its deep forward and backward linkages.

demand_outlook.claim: Two-wheeler production recorded robust year-on-year growth of 22.8% in Q1 FY27.
demand_outlook.quote: The two-wheeler segment, which is most relevant to us, recorded production growth of 22.8% on a year-on-year basis, with total two-wheeler production of 72.5 lakh units in Q1 FY27, up from 59.50 lakh units in the same quarter last year.

demand_outlook.claim: ASK Automotive's revenue growth outperformed industry growth in Q1 FY27.
The Indian two-wheeler industry achieved production volumes of 26.7 million units in FY26 compared to 23.9 million units in FY25.
demand_outlook.quote: The two-wheeler industry closed FY26 with a strong production volume of 26.7 million units, up from 23.9 million units in FY25.

demand_outlook.claim: ASK Automotive's independent aftermarket revenue grew by 24.7% in FY26.
demand_outlook.quote: Happy to share that our independent aftermarket has grown by 24.7% in FY26.

demand_outlook.claim: Advanced braking system revenue grew by 32% in Q4 FY26 and 17% overall in FY26 year-on-year.
demand_outlook.quote: Our advanced braking system revenue grew by 32% in Q4 FY26 and 17% in FY26 on year-on-year basis.

demand_outlook.claim: Aluminium light-weighting precision solutions revenue registered growth of 47% in Q4 FY26 and 30% in FY26 year-on-year.
demand_outlook.quote: The aluminium light-weighting precision solutions revenue grew by 47% in Q4 FY26 and 30% in FY26 on year-on-year basis.

demand_outlook.claim: Safety control cable revenue expanded by 26% in Q4 FY26 and 14% in FY26 on a year-on-year basis.
demand_outlook.quote: The safety control cable revenue also recorded growth of 26% in Q4 FY26 and 14% in FY26 on year-on-year basis.

capex_expansion.claim: The second captive solar plant of 11.55 megawatts at Bikaner is ready and expected to be commissioned in Q2 FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: Our second captive solar plant of 11.55 megawatts at Bikaner, Rajasthan is ready and is expected to be commissioned in Q2FY27.

capex_expansion.claim: Total capital expenditure for the year may reach around Rs. 700 crore due to new order wins and the setup of a new plant in the South.
capex_expansion.quote: We had given guidance about around Rs. 450 crore to Rs. 500 crore, but the way we are going and receiving the orders, as I today revised the guidance to high-teens, I think our capex may go to something like Rs. 700 crore this year.

capex_expansion.claim: A 9.9 MWp solar power plant for captive consumption has been operationalized.
capex_expansion.quote: 9.9 MWp Solar Power Plant for captive consumption operationalized.

capex_expansion.claim: ASK Automotive plans to invest around Rs. 400 Cr in capex in FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: For next year growth of mid-teens, we need to invest around RS.400 Cr which we shall be investing in this year also.

capex_expansion.claim: Out of the planned capex, maintenance budget accounts for Rs. 40 to Rs. 50 Cr while the rest will be deployed for new plant capacities.
capex_expansion.quote: Capex breakup is very little is the maintenance budget, that's about Rs.40 to Rs. 50 Cr, rest is all the capex for the new plant capacities, which we keep on adding.

capex_expansion.claim: A 9.9 megawatt captive solar plant in Sirsa, Haryana has been fully operational since April 2025.
capex_expansion.quote: I am happy to update that our 9.9 megawatt solar plant at Sirsa, Haryana has been fully operational since April 2025 and is delivering the sustainable operational economies on the expected lines.

capex_expansion.claim: A second captive solar plant of 11.55 megawatt in Bikaner, Rajasthan is scheduled for commissioning in Q2 FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: Our second captive solar plant of 11.55 megawatt in Bikaner, Rajasthan is progressing well and is expected to be commissioned in Q2 FY27, this reflects ASK's special focus on green energy.

margins_costs.claim: Aluminum prices are expected to remain benign in the coming quarters, anticipating an improvement in EBITDA margins.
margins_costs.quote: However, with aluminum prices expected to remain benign in the coming quarters, we anticipate an improvement in our EBITDA margins.

margins_costs.claim: Consolidated EBITDA margin stood at 12.0% in Q1 FY27.
ASK Automotive generated consolidated EBITDA of Rs. 140 Cr with a margin of 12.1% in Q4 FY26.
margins_costs.quote: We achieved EBITDA of Rs. 140 Cr with 31.1% year-on-year growth. EBITDA margin at 12.1%, however, this EBITDA percentage was impacted due to pass-through alloy prices as mentioned earlier.

margins_costs.claim: Pass-through alloy prices reduced Q4 FY26 EBITDA margin by 80 basis points.
margins_costs.quote: For this impact, EBITDA percentage would have been higher by 80 basis points.

margins_costs.claim: Full year FY26 EBITDA stood at Rs. 551 Cr with an EBITDA margin of 13.1%.
margins_costs.quote: We achieved EBITDA of Rs. 551 Cr with 24.1% year-on-year growth. EBITDA margin at 13.1%, however, EBITDA percentage was impacted due to pass-through alloy prices.

margins_costs.claim: The company absorbed a Rs. 5 Cr loss in March as abrupt aluminium price increases could not be passed immediately to the aftermarket.
margins_costs.quote: There was a conscious loss by us of Rs. 5 Cr because every day we cannot increase the prices and the prices were rising actually every day.

orders_capacity.claim: Technical collaboration with Kyushu Yanagawa Japan was implemented at the Karoli plant and supplies of high pressure die casted alloy wheels have commenced to a Japanese customer.
orders_capacity.quote: Happy to share that the technical collaboration with Kyushu Yanagawa Japan has been successfully implemented at our Karoli plant and 1st Supply of High Pressure Die Casted Alloy Wheel has started to our leading Japanese customer.

orders_capacity.claim: Capacity utilization at the third Bengaluru plant reached 90%.
orders_capacity.quote: Very, very happy to share that Bangalore we have reached 90% capacity utilization that we set up last year, our 18th plant and the third plant in Bengaluru.

orders_capacity.claim: Capacity utilization at the Karoli plant currently stands at 65%.
orders_capacity.quote: In the Karoli plant, the capacities utilization is still 65%, that is the reason that we have made investment for the alloy wheels.

orders_capacity.claim: Revenue from the low-margin wheel assembly business will be zero starting April 1, 2026.
orders_capacity.quote: From 1st April 2026, wheel assembly revenue will be nil.

capital_allocation.claim: Internal accruals will be sufficient for funding capex, supplemented by external financing and term loans for cash flow management.
capital_allocation.quote: We are actually keeping in mind our high mid-teen growth, our internal accruals will be sufficient; but yes, for cash flow management, we will have to take some external financing.

capital_allocation.claim: Wheel assembly sales became nil effective April 1, 2026, following strategic closure of the business.
capital_allocation.quote: *With effect from 01.04.2026, WA Sales are Nil

capital_allocation.claim: The board recommended a dividend of 92.5%, equal to Rs. 1.85 per equity share.
capital_allocation.quote: The board has recommended a dividend of 92.5%, that is Rs. 1.85 per equity share of face value of Rs. 2 each.

capital_allocation.claim: The company plans to plough back internal free cash flow to keep debt levels within limits.
capital_allocation.quote: All these internal accruals free cash will be ploughed back in the company, so we will see to it even the debt levels are contained within the limits.

risks_headwinds.claim: Geopolitical conflict in West Asia created undue volatility in energy, commodity, and currency markets, causing a sharp increase in aluminum alloy prices.
risks_headwinds.quote: As you are aware, after 28th February 2026, the geopolitical conflict in West Asia had created undue volatility in energy, commodity, and currency markets, and had led to a sharp, phenomenal increase in aluminum alloy prices, which affected our industry.

risks_headwinds.claim: Geopolitical conflicts in West Asia after February 28, 2026 created volatility in energy, commodities, currency, and supply chains.
risks_headwinds.quote: After 28th February, 2026, geopolitical conflict in West Asia has disrupted the global economy, posing an unprecedented challenge in supply chain, creating undue volatility in energy, commodity and currency across the globe and it has started affecting Indian economy as well.

risks_headwinds.claim: FY26 export revenue fell to Rs. 141 Cr from Rs. 147 Cr in FY25 due to trade disruptions, tariffs, supply chain issues, and logistics costs.
risks_headwinds.quote: Our revenue from exports were at Rs. 141 Cr in FY26 against Rs. 147 Cr last year because of the trade disruptions due to higher tariff rates, geopolitical tensions, supply chain issues, logistic costs and other bottlenecks.

risks_headwinds.claim: Increases in minimum wages by state governments and surging aluminium alloy prices created cost pressures across the industry.
risks_headwinds.quote: Recent developments in geopolitical scenario and significant increase in minimum wages by some of the state governments has created an input cost pressure on the industry.

management_commitments.claim: The second captive solar power plant at Bikaner is expected to be commissioned in Q2 FY27.
management_commitments.quote: Our second captive solar plant of 11.55 megawatts at Bikaner, Rajasthan is ready and is expected to be commissioned in Q2FY27.

management_commitments.claim: Initial supplies for the sunroof cables business will start from H2.
management_commitments.quote: Initial supplies will start from H2, but next year, you will see substantial growth there.

management_commitments.claim: ASK Automotive expects to maintain mid-teens revenue growth in FY27.
management_commitments.quote: We are confident that will continue to grow around mid-teens in FY27.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects to commission its 11.55 megawatt solar plant in Bikaner during Q2 FY27.
management_commitments.quote: Our second captive solar plant of 11.55 megawatt in Bikaner, Rajasthan is progressing well and is expected to be commissioned in Q2 FY27, this reflects ASK's special focus on green energy.

management_commitments.claim: The company targets alloy wheels revenue of Rs. 90 - Rs. 100 Cr in FY27 and about Rs. 220 Cr in FY28.
management_commitments.quote: FY27 we are expecting revenue of around Rs. 90 - Rs. 100 Cr and FY28 will be about Rs. 220 Cr.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
